headline: Hey, I'm Jessie.
Mostly I help folks prep travel into mainland China.
paragraphs: Used to write front end. Did a gap year WHV in Australia. Now I geek out wiring real trips for visitors: routing, sleeps, Alipay, WeChat, rideshare, SIM quirks, pacing that does not wreck your first week.
Site stays drafty on purpose. I'd rather revise old posts than fake I never flubbed anything.
Email anytime I usually ping back fast. Aus and stray trip notes live below mainland China pulls the busiest mail lately.
